chosen_titles.rationale: Title 24 (Government - State) houses C.R.S. Article 6 Part 3, the Colorado lobbyist-regulation/disclosure regime; CO codifies lobbying under this state-government title.

notes: Vintage 2015 absent from Justia: https://law.justia.com/codes/colorado/2015/ returns a 404 'Page not found' (saved as pass1_state_index_2015_404.html); the /codes/colorado/ all-versions page (pass0_all_versions.tsv) lists earliest available vintage as 2016. Substituted to 2016 (one year off, within ±5-year window). Pass-1 snapshot used is the /codes/colorado/2016/ title index (43 titles); only Title 24 references the state-government code where lobbyist regulation lives. Title 2 (Legislative) was considered and rejected: CO's lobbying-disclosure statute (C.R.S. §24-6-301 et seq.) sits in Title 24 Art. 6 Part 3, not in Title 2.
